review.why: Scores a pasted LinkedIn profile against a 12-item rubric and rewrites the weakest parts.
review.summary: Scores a LinkedIn profile out of 100 using a bundled rubric file, then rewrites headline, About and other sections in descending order of points lost. Works from pasted text and does not log in.
strengths: Explicit scoring rubric and rewrite order
cautions: Short, no scripts or examples beyond the rubric
